title: VA-01: GAO-25-106969 Recommendation 2 artifact scope audit
publisher: U.S. Government Accountability Office and named implementing agency
summary: GAO-25-106969 Recommendation 2 remains Open. Phase 56S checks three directive elements and classifies the public document result as scope-adjacent public material located.
key_findings: Availability class: Scope-adjacent public material located.
Repository finding: Relevant official public material was located, but it does not expose or satisfy every element of the exact response artifact.
Scope element 1: Governance and leadership commitment — Partly supported by located public record. VHA publicly describes an enterprise-risk function.

Scope element 2: Risk identification, assessment, response, and monitoring across the system — Partly supported by located public record. The public page states the function but does not demonstrate full leading-practice operation.
Scope element 3: Evidence of implementation and continuous improvement — Not established by located public record. No recommendation-specific operating record located.
FTFN public-scope check: 0 supported, 2 partial, and 1 not established across three directive elements.
GAO acceptance state: Implementation not yet demonstrated.

Continuation rule: Continue the Phase 56R rule and recheck exact agency repositories plus the GAO product page when a named artifact or status changes. An availability result or FTFN scope check cannot substitute for GAO acceptance.
why_it_matters: Document-level scope checks show exactly what a public artifact covers, what remains unavailable, and why availability cannot be converted into implementation or closure.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves VA-01 and its exact recommendation identity.
Records an official repository search trail and explicit public-availability result.
Separates FTFN's visible-scope check from GAO acceptance, implementation, closure, and operating outcomes.
evidence_limits: Not publicly located does not mean nonexistent or withheld.
A public document may be scope-adjacent without being the exact implementation artifact.
FTFN document-scope findings do not substitute for GAO's recommendation-status decision.
Document evidence does not establish performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, ranking, composite score, or causation.
